node src/server.js >/tmp/small-file-service.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$!

printf '%s\\n' '--- no token ---'
curl -sS -i http://127.0.0.1:8080/?name=report.txt
printf '%s\\n' '--- default token ---'
curl -sS -i -H 'x-admin-token: admin' 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/?name=../../etc/passwd'
printf '%s\\n' '--- missing name ---'
curl -sS -i -H 'x-admin-token: admin' http://127.0.0.1:8080/
printf '%s\\n' '--- server log ---'
cat /tmp/small-file-service.log"
